                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Team mission<\/strong><\/h3>

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          GetYourGuide knows a great deal about every traveler, and almost none of it is usable today. Identity, booking history, browsing behavior, care conversations, preferences and predictions sit in separate systems, in different shapes, so every team that wants to act on what we know rebuilds its own partial version of it. The User Platform team is building the traveler context layer: resolving who someone is across devices and sessions, and turning scattered signals into a shared, interpretable and predictive understanding that every team can build on. We start with travelers, because that is where the leverage is, and the layer is designed to extend to our other users over time.<\/p>

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Your mission<\/strong><\/h3>

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          As a Lead Product Manager, you will own the vision and strategy for a new platform at GetYourGuide, and you will be the first product manager on the team that builds it. Working with an Engineering Manager, engineers, an embedded data scientist and an analyst, you will define what the traveler context layer holds, how it is served, and which problems it solves first. This is a genuine zero to one: the identity model, the semantic memory that both humans and LLMs can read, the forward-looking predictions on top of it, and the self-serve interfaces that make it usable are all still to be designed.<\/p>

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          The work is equal parts product craft and demand creation. Our consumers are other teams: search and ranking, lifecycle and paid channels, customer care, and the traveler experience itself. Their need is real and widely felt, but they struggle to define what would really solve their problems.<\/p>

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          We are looking for a product leader who is fluent in data and machine learning without needing to be a data scientist, who is comfortable when the scope of a domain is still being drawn, and who wants to build the foundation that personalization at GetYourGuide will run on for years.<\/p>

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              We're building the engine that will teach robots to do real work in the real world.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               You will work shoulder to shoulder with our model engineering and research teams, turning their requests into physical demonstrations and feeding what you learn on the floor back to them.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               <\/p>
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              What you will do<\/strong><\/h2>
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Help lead the Paris data collection floor.<\/strong> Set the execution and quality bar for day-to-day collection work and help the team scale effectively.<\/p><\/li>

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Build repeatable tasks.<\/strong> Turn new collection requests into clear, repeatable processes that can be executed consistently by other operators.<\/p><\/li>

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Write and improve the playbook.<\/strong> Own SOPs, quality checks, and training materials that allow the Paris operation to scale while maintaining a consistent quality bar.<\/p><\/li>
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Guide other operators.<\/strong> Help onboard, train, and mentor operators and reinforce consistent execution across the team.<\/p><\/li>

Description

About AllCloud

AllCloud is a leader in amplifying organizations’ cloud potential through AI. With a track record of hundreds of successful migrations and implementations across AWS and Salesforce, AllCloud has developed strategies and solutions that enable businesses of all sizes to remain at the forefront of innovation.

AllCloud is a leader in AI-led professional and managed services. As an AWS Premier and audited managed services Partner, and Salesforce Consulting partner, AllCloud provides comprehensive AI-led cloud journey support, from initial migration to ongoing management through our Engage Managed Services. Our expertise ensures that clients remain aligned with ecosystem best practices while focusing on their core business growth.

AllCloud serves clients across the globe with offices in EMEA and North America.

About the Role

We're looking for a hands-on Security Operations Engineer in Romania to join our global Information Security team, reporting directly to the CISO. You'll protect AllCloud's corporate environment, cloud workloads, and customer trust. That covers detection, incident response, vulnerability management, and supporting our compliance programs (SOC 2, ISO 27001).

What You'll Do

  • Monitor, investigate, and respond to security alerts across cloud, endpoint, identity, and SaaS environments
  • Improve incident response processes: playbooks, triage, containment, post-incident reviews, and reporting
  • Build and tune detections and correlation rules in SIEM/XDR platforms
  • Run vulnerability management: scan, prioritize, track fixes with IT and engineering, and report on progress
  • Automate security workflows with scripting and SOAR, or with serverless or GenAI tools
  • Run phishing simulations and security awareness work
  • Work with IT, DevOps, Legal and business teams across AllCloud's global offices to embed security into daily operations
  • Support audits and compliance work (SOC 2, ISO 27001): gather evidence, monitor controls and maintain policies, including in GRC platforms

Requirements

What You Bring

  • 5+ years in security operations, SOC, incident response, or a similar security engineering role
  • Experience with SIEM/XDR/EDR tools
  • Solid understanding of networking, Windows/Linux, identity, and common attack techniques (MITRE ATT&CK)
  • Experience in incident response from detection through remediation
  • Scripting skills in Python, PowerShell, or Bash
  • Strong analytical and communication skills; you can explain risk to technical and non-technical people
  • Fluent English, written and spoken
  • Able to work across time zones with distributed teams

Nice to Have

  • Strong hands-on experience securing AWS environments
  • AWS Security Specialty, Security+, CySA+, GCIH, GCIA or similar certifications
  • Experience with SOAR, Infrastructure as Code (Terraform / CloudFormation) or detection-as-code
  • Experience with AWS security
  • Background at an MSSP or a cloud consulting company
  • Experience with SOC 2 / ISO 27001 audits and GRC tools

Why work for us?

Our team inspires progress in each other and in our customers through our relentless pursuit of excellence; you will work with leaders who promote learning and personal development.

AllCloud is an Equal Opportunity Employer and considers applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, orientation, national origin, age, disability, genetics or any other basis forbidden under federal, provincial, or local law.

      <title>Bybit: Blockchain Risk Control Lead</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Front-End Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Europe - Remote
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About Us</strong></p>
<div>
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-XCikdRR2xoZIjdxtCKcuOflrs8d">Established in 2018, Bybit is one of the world’s leading cryptocurrency exchanges and digital financial platforms, serving over 80 million users across more than 200 countries and regions. Powered by world-class technology and a user-first mindset, Bybit delivers a seamless ecosystem across trading, payments, wealth management, custody, institutional services, and Web3 — connecting users to the future of digital finance.</div>
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-IF06dI0MPoBwYfxbZ4zui13HsoC">&nbsp;</div>
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-X5EbdOwvMoYuOmxQBbuueUEDsDd">Our core values define how we build. We listen, care and improve to create products and experiences that put users first. Backed by a global team of ambitious builders, problem-solvers, and innovators, we foster a high-performance and fast-moving environment where talent is empowered to drive real impact at the global scale. Supported by 24/7 multilingual customer service and a strong commitment to innovation, we are shaping the future of finance through technology, collaboration, and bold execution.</div>
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-LtVud2dO7oglqJxxZoOucqjJsPc">&nbsp;</div>
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-RMHkdm4bPo66l3xMVO8ui1o8sle">Today, Bybit is recognized as one of the most trusted and transparent platforms in the digital asset industry, continuing to expand its global presence while building the infrastructure for the next generation of financial services.</div>
</div></div><div>
<div>
<div>
<div>
<div>
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-XBlLddy3VoNT3txbaGNun1hrsPf">
<div>
<h3 class="heading-3 ace-line old-record-id-doxusHGfakvLWaL8WPWprXPeF6g">Job Brief</h3>
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-doxustWQGDcYdsXZKzz6jW3iqzf">We are expanding our focus to cover AI-augmented threat intelligence and post-quantum cryptographic (PQC) security. The ideal candidate will combine deep blockchain forensics expertise with working knowledge of machine learning techniques for anomaly detection, and awareness of quantum computing threats to current cryptographic foundations (ECDSA, RSA) used across blockchain ecosystems. We value candidates who can bridge academia and industry and build collaborative relationships with research institutions to accelerate the adoption of emerging cryptographic and AI-driven techniques within the company.</div>
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-GgRydFSptomveSxMGexu0LdAsAd">&nbsp;</div>
<h3 class="heading-3 ace-line old-record-id-doxus6p2Feyu3IDbsRmQ37giNic">Main Responsibilities of a Blockchain Risk Control Analyst/Researcher</h3>
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-doxus9nxhMp5469L98BCuHVf09b">Your main responsibilities will include:</div>
<ul class="list-bullet1">
<li class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-doxushSEZSiy20NhXbosiIzl2he">
<div>Leveraging LLM techniques to drive the development of next-generation on-chain risk identification and threat intelligence systems, including autonomous agent workflows capable of continuous monitoring, self-triggered investigation, and automated operational responses — reducing manual intervention across the full risk lifecycle from detection to resolution;</div>
</li>
<li class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-doxusj58brgTkRTa08Q6h9ApwKh">
<div>Leading forensic investigations on real crypto theft, fraud, and market manipulation cases, integrating AI-assisted pattern recognition to accelerate root cause analysis;</div>
</li>
<li class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-doxusPaLjsYOqBVcfnrLgSnu5Jb">
<div>Researching post-quantum cryptographic algorithms (NIST PQC: ML-KEM, ML-DSA, SLH-DSA, FALCON) and their implications for blockchain security; assessing quantum computing threats to existing cryptographic foundations (ECDSA secp256k1, hash functions) and evaluating migration paths;</div>
</li>
<li class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-doxus7dSIpm4e7cH1HoV09o6Cqh">
<div>Partnering with internal teams and external stakeholders for incident response, and engaging with academic institutions to translate frontier research into deployable security tools;</div>
</li>
</ul>
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-SqM4d4wIuoeirzxHey4uoZxGsN0">&nbsp;</div>
<h3 class="heading-3 ace-line old-record-id-doxus6uThYblSFlJTXZtdILCvXg">Key Requirements</h3>
<ul class="list-bullet1">
<li class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-doxus3DoTlgQkg41P1oEinoEDWd">
<div>You have a Master's or PhD's degree in Blockchain security, Computer Science, Data Science, or a related field.</div>
</li>
<li class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-doxusn5hLHT3hAP3ixYUCRWol8g">
<div>You are good at programming languages commonly used in blockchain analytics (e.g., SQL, Python, Javascript)</div>
</li>
<li class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-doxusiKgRvnwLj6FEqgpdV85fIc">
<div>Experience applying machine learning or AI techniques to blockchain data analysis, fraud detection, or threat intelligence</div>
</li>
<li class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-doxus8cJMCTCWLcSdERosDe8jPg">
<div>A strong publication record in top-level industry or academic conferences is highly valued.</div>
</li>
<li class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-doxuskDSmyWRUZ0wV14aN5gVv3c">
<div>You have experience with blockchain monitoring/forensic tools and analytics platforms.</div>
</li>
<li class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-doxus72LB2B4fEgnhhFs1D8FxZb">
<div>Familiarity with NIST PQC standards (ML-KEM, ML-DSA, SLH-DSA, FALCON) and lattice/hash-based cryptography fundamentals is a plus;</div>
</li>
<li class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-doxusoxtnXehgu8HQUX4NT9sAFf">
<div>Understanding of quantum computing threats to elliptic curve cryptography and implications for key management in Web3;</div>
</li>
<li class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-doxusHQbIAMZZdN6NKSB7hfWx6f">
<div>You have security or risk control experience as a plus.</div>
</li>
<li class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-doxussxPbYU5Du2OH3pSYD1cv6d">
<div>You possess effective communication and collaboration abilities.</div>
</li>
<li class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-doxusKYrFNrTTBuCbwMuJ0vvpng">
<div>English is essential, and proficiency in Mandarin can be an advantage.</div>
</li>
</ul>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Why Join Us</strong><br>At Bybit, we are committed to fostering a supportive and enriching work environment.&nbsp;<br>Our benefits include:<br>- Study Growth Fund: We support your professional development and continuous learning.<br>- Internal Events: Participate in regular team-building activities, workshops, and events designed to promote collaboration and innovation.<br>- Global Collaboration: Be part of a diverse, international team, working alongside colleagues from around the world.<br>- Career Advancement: Access opportunities for growth and advancement within a rapidly expanding global company.<br>- Internal Mobility: Grow with us- Your long-term development is important to us. We offer internal job opportunities to help build your career path.</p></div>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/bybit-blockchain-risk-control-lead">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/bybit-blockchain-risk-control-lead</a></p>
</description>

      <title>Affirm: Analytics Engineer II, Full Stack (Revenue Analytics)</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote Poland
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><p>At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.</p></div><p>We’re looking for a curious, driven professional to join our Revenue Analytics team. This builds and owns the data products, reporting infrastructure, semantic foundations, and analytical systems that power Affirm’s Revenue organization.<br>As a Senior Analyst, Revenue Analytics, you’ll build scalable data products that power day-to-day decision-making - owning end-to-end work across data modeling, metric definitions, dashboards, automation, and enablement.&nbsp;<br>You’ll also help strengthen our semantic layer and data governance, laying the foundation for reliable AI. The ideal candidate combines strong technical and analytical skills with the ability to turn ambiguous business questions into durable, well-tested data infrastructure.</p>
<p><strong>What you'll do</strong>&nbsp;</p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>Develop dbt data models, dashboards, metrics, and automation processes for the revenue field team and revenue analysts</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Build and maintain critical reporting data models that power external merchant reporting&nbsp;</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Build the semantic, metadata, and context layers that allow AI systems to accurately understand Revenue data, metrics, and business definitions</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Partner with Business Systems, engineering, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into durable, well-tested data products</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Contribute to the team’s best practices in version control, code review, documentation, and release hygiene (GitHub-based workflows)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Develop processes, governance, and foundations to scale the impact of analytics within Revenue.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p><br><strong>What we look for</strong>&nbsp;</p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>3+ years of work experience in an analytics engineering or business intelligence role</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Strong working knowledge of SQL, dbt, Python, data modeling, and data visualization&nbsp;</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Hands-on experience with BI tools (Sigma/Looker/Tableau), Databricks, and cloud data warehouses (Snowflake)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Understanding of the data foundations required for reliable AI, including semantic layers, metadata, evals, metric definitions, documentation, and data quality</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Demonstrated experience integrating AI tools into day-to-day analytics engineering workflows to improve development speed, quality, and scalability</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Familiarity with Salesforce and experience supporting commercial areas of the business</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Ability to identify user needs and translate them into robust, scalable data products</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Ability to start with an ambiguous problem, deconstruct it into tangible steps, and work toward an impactful solution</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Ability to communicate findings and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>Total rewards</strong></h3>
<div>
<p>We believe the people building honest financial products at Affirm should share in its success. That's why our total rewards are designed to support your health, growth, financial well-being,&nbsp;and future.</p>
<p>In service of our mission, we reward employees through a combination of base pay, equity (from&nbsp;parent company), and comprehensive benefits.</p>
<p><strong>Base Pay Grade</strong>&nbsp;<strong>- K<br></strong><strong>226 000 zł &nbsp;-&nbsp; 346 000 zł &nbsp;<em>&nbsp;&nbsp;</em>&nbsp;&nbsp;<br></strong></p>
<p>Base pay ranges and placement within those ranges are determined based on several factors, including role, experience, and job-related skills.</p>
<p>In addition to base pay, all employees in this role are eligible to receive equity from the parent company each year. This means as Affirm’s parent company grows, employees have the opportunity to share in that growth financially.<br><br></p>
<p><strong>Equity Grade - 2 (awarded in US Dollars)</strong></p>
<p><strong>Affirm Holdings, Inc. Equity Grade example<br><br></strong><strong>Equity grade: </strong><strong>2<br></strong><strong>New hire equity: </strong><strong>$16,000-$24,000<br></strong><strong>Annual Refresh: </strong><strong>$5,000<br></strong><strong>Reward equity: </strong><strong>$0-$75,000</strong></p>
<p>Affirm also provides flexible spending wallets to all employees for technology and wellbeing related needs, which are reimbursable up to <strong>1390</strong> <strong>zł </strong>per month.</p>
<p><strong>In addition to your compensation, our comprehensive benefits are designed to support you and the people who matter most. Benefits include:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Competitive paid time off, paid public holidays, and additional paid Away Days to rest and recharge.</li>
<li>Comprehensive private healthcare through Lux Med's Platinum package.</li>
<li>A MultiSport card to support your health and well-being.</li>
<li>Learning and development programs to help you grow professionally.&nbsp;</li>
<li>Family healthcare support through Maven and parental leave support through Parentaly.</li>
<li>Mental well-being support through Lyra, including up to 12 confidential counseling or coaching sessions each year for you and your household members.</li>
<li>Financial well-being support through Northstar, with unlimited access to Certified Financial Advisors and planning tools at no cost to you.</li>
<li>Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) that foster connection and inclusion.</li>
<li>Eligibility for creative tax benefits, subject to applicable law, role, and company policy.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Location - Remote Poland</strong></p>
<p><em>The majority of our roles can be located anywhere in Poland.</em></p>
<p><em>**This job description is not a contractual document, and is not intended to have binding force.**</em></p>
<p><strong>#LI-Remote</strong></p>
</div><div class="content-conclusion"><div>
<p><strong>Remote-first with flexibility built in</strong><strong><br></strong>Affirm is proud to be a remote-first company. Most roles can be done from almost anywhere within the country of employment. Some positions may occasionally require in-person work at an Affirm office, and a few are office-based due to the nature of the work. All new hires will be invited to attend an in-person onboarding experience.</p>
<p><strong>Benefits designed for you</strong><strong><br></strong>Our benefits reflect our commitment to care, transparency, and flexibility. Here are a few highlights:</p>
<ul>
<li>Health coverage at no cost: We cover 100% of premiums for employees and their dependents.</li>
<li>Spending stipends: Monthly stipends support your tech setup, and the ability to choose health and wellness options that are right for you.</li>
<li>Time off to recharge: Flexible time off and generous holiday calendars help you rest when you need to.</li>
<li>Own a piece of what you build: Our employee stock purchase plan (ESPP) lets you buy Affirm stock at a discount.</li>
</ul>
<p>We’re committed to providing an inclusive interview process, including accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you need support, we’re happy to help.</p>
<p>For positions based in San Francisco or Los Angeles: Affirm considers qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, as required by law.</p>
</div>
<div>
<p>By clicking "Submit Application," you acknowledge that you have read Affirm's&nbsp;<a href="https://www.affirm.com/global-candidate-privacy-notice">Global Candidate Privacy Notice</a> and consent to the use of your personal information as described.</p>
</div></div>

      <title>Netlify: Senior Staff Data Scientist</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote
</p>

<p><strong>About the Team:</strong></p>
<p>Netlify’s Data team helps the company understand and improve the full product-led growth journey, from activation and engagement through conversion, retention, and monetization. We partner closely with Product, Engineering, and Growth to uncover opportunities, evaluate investments, and understand what drives customer and business outcomes.</p>
<p>We’re hiring a Senior Staff Data Scientist to deepen how data shapes our product and growth strategy. You’ll develop an end-to-end understanding of the PLG journey, proactively identify opportunities, and turn complex data into hypotheses, experiments, and recommendations that influence where we invest and what we build. This is a highly autonomous role for someone who can move from identifying an important question to shaping the approach, defining success, and driving toward an answer.</p>
<p><strong>What You'll Do:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Own the analytical understanding of Netlify’s PLG performance across activation, engagement, conversion, monetization, and retention, identifying opportunities before they become requests</li>
<li>Partner with Product and Engineering leadership to turn behavioral insights into product bets, defining what to test, how to measure it, and what the results mean</li>
<li>Lead experimentation from hypothesis through decision, including study design, methodology, success metrics, guardrails, analysis, and recommendations</li>
<li>Apply statistical rigor where it matters while recognizing when there is enough signal to make a decision and move forward, and help teams develop that same judgment</li>
<li>Build scalable analytical systems like semantic models, trusted metrics, proactive monitoring, and AI-powered agents&nbsp; that surface opportunities without waiting to be asked</li>
<li>Use AI to investigate faster, automate recurring analytical work, and test more hypotheses without sacrificing the judgment that makes the output useful</li>
<li>Identify gaps in measurement, event instrumentation, and metric definitions, and partner with Data and Product Engineering to close them</li>
<li>Serve as a trusted analytical partner to PLG leadership, using evidence and product judgment to influence investment decisions and roadmap priorities</li>
<li>Influence product strategy through evidence, product instincts, and a clear point of view, without relying on formal authority to do it</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>What You'll Bring:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>8+ years of experience in product analytics, growth analytics, or data science, with a track record of high ownership and measurable impact on PLG or consumer product outcomes</li>
<li>Deep understanding of product and growth dynamics across activation, engagement, conversion, monetization, and retention</li>
<li>Demonstrated ability to turn behavioral data into product hypotheses and carry them from insight through experimentation and measured outcomes</li>
<li>Deep experimentation expertise: study design, statistical reasoning, causal inference, and the judgment to know when an experiment has told you what you need to know</li>
<li>Experience building analytical systems such as metrics layers, monitoring frameworks, or semantic models that teams can rely on over time</li>
<li>An AI-native approach to analysis: you use AI tools actively to accelerate investigation, automate repetitive work, and surface patterns faster</li>
<li>A track record of influencing senior stakeholders and product direction through analytical reasoning, clear recommendations, and sound judgment</li>
<li>Comfort operating with significant autonomy in ambiguous problem spaces, including determining which questions are most important to answer</li>
<li>Strong written and verbal communication skills in distributed environments, with the ability to make complex findings clear and recommendations actionable</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>This Role is a Great Fit If:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>You're energized by finding the opportunity before anyone thought to ask - proactive discovery is how you naturally work, not a mode you shift into</li>
<li>You think like a product person who happens to be exceptionally rigorous with data, not a data person who occasionally weighs in on product</li>
<li>&nbsp;You thrive when the problem isn't handed to you - you'd rather define the question worth asking than answer the one that landed in your queue</li>
<li>You get excited about building systems that keep working after you've moved on to the next problem</li>
<li>You're comfortable making a call with imperfect information and can articulate clearly why you made it</li>
<li>You enjoy being a thought partner to senior leaders - shaping how they think about investment and opportunity, not just supporting decisions already made</li>
<li>You work well in a remote-first, async environment where written clarity and self-direction matter more than proximity</li>
<li>You're drawn to roles where the measure of success is outcomes, decisions made, bets tested, metrics moved, not volume of output produced</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Applying</strong></p>
<p>Not sure you meet 100% of our qualifications? <strong>Please apply anyway!</strong></p>
<p>When applying please include:&nbsp;</p>
<p>A resume or short listing of your job history &amp; skills (link to a LinkedIn profile would be fine). We appreciate a cover letter explaining why you would enjoy working in this role at Netlify to get to know you a bit better, though this is not required and will not impact your application. Our mission is to “build a better web” and that cannot be done without a diversity of skill sets, backgrounds and thoughts.&nbsp;</p>
<p>Of everything we've ever built at Netlify, we are most proud of our team. Netlify is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are devoted to building a team of people with diverse backgrounds and lifestyles. Driving equality empowers our team, enables us to innovate, and helps us maintain a more inclusive environment. We don’t discriminate against employees or applicants based on gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, race, military/veteran status, citizenship, pregnancy status, or any other differences. If we can do anything to provide a better interview, i.e. accommodate a disability, then please let us know by emailing <a href="mailto:accomodations@netlify.com">accommodations@netlify.com</a>.&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>About Netlify</strong></p>
<p>Netlify is the most popular way to build, deploy, and scale modern web applications, empowering everyone from fast moving solo developers to enterprise teams. Millions of developers and organizations rely on Netlify as their platform of choice for composing web applications that are production ready, performant, and flexible. Now, as we embrace the next era of software development, we are embedding the same fluid, intuitive experience into the Agent Experience (AX), making it just as simple for intelligent agents to understand, interact with, and act on our platform as it is for developers. Whether your user is human or machine, Netlify ensures the path from idea to URL is seamless, fast, and deeply reliable.</p>
<p>We are a Series D company that has raised over $200M from investors such as Andreessen Horowitz, Kleiner Perkins, EQT, Bessemer, BOND, and Menlo Ventures. As a fully distributed company, we aim to create a company culture where the best idea can come from anywhere and strive to be thoughtful, compassionate, and collaborative in our work. If this sounds like something you’d like to be part of, we’re excited to connect with you!</p>
<p>At Netlify, we are committed to a compensation philosophy that prioritizes fairness and equity, positions our employee compensation competitively in the market, recognizes and rewards performance, and takes a comprehensive approach to our rewards package. We anchor our compensation philosophy on a market-based approach, therefore salary ranges may differ depending on the labor cost in a particular location. The salary provided is in addition to robust benefits and participation in Netlify’s equity plan. Our hiring range for this role is targeted at $204,000 - $275,000 for most US-based locations.&nbsp; Candidates outside the US or in premium markets should consult with their Talent Acquisition partner regarding location-based ranges, as they may be higher or lower than the average US range listed. The starting pay will be determined based on multiple factors, including expertise and skills, market demands, experience, internal equity, and applicable geographic location. These compensation packages and ranges are subject to change and may be modified in the future.</p>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/netlify-senior-staff-data-scientist">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/netlify-senior-staff-data-scientist</a></p>
</description>

      <title>Mercury: Business Continuity Management Lead</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> San Francisco, CA, New York, NY, Portland, OR, or Remote within Canada or United States
</p>

<h3><strong>About the Role</strong></h3>
<p>Mercury is seeking a Business Continuity Management (BCM) Lead to build and lead an enterprise-wide continuity program as we prepare to become a bank. As part of the Risk team, this leader will establish practical standards, clear accountability, and tested capabilities to maintain critical services and recover effectively from disruptions, with direct visibility to the CRO and senior leadership.</p>
<p>This role fills the need for a dedicated leader to coordinate BCM across the organization. The ideal candidate combines deep continuity and resilience expertise with the judgment to build a proportionate program in a fast-moving environment, working effectively with Engineering, Operations, Product, Information Security, Legal, Compliance, and business teams.</p>
<p>The BCM Lead will own the enterprise framework, coordination, oversight, and reporting. Business and technology owners will remain accountable for their continuity plans and recovery execution.Because this is a new program, the Lead will be hands-on in the initial build: facilitating the first round of BIAs and plans side by side with owners, running exercises, and driving identified gaps through remediation. This leader will also work closely with Engineering on technology disaster recovery and with relevant teams on incident response, crisis management, and third-party resilience.</p>
<h3><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>Develop and implement Mercury’s enterprise BCM framework, policies, standards, governance, and operating model, with a prioritized implementation roadmap aligned to bank-launch readiness and critical services.</li>
<li>Partner with business owners to identify critical services, conduct business impact analyses (customer, financial, operational, and regulatory), and map dependencies across people, processes, technology, facilities, and third parties, including single points of failure.</li>
<li>Establish recovery time objectives (RTOs) and recovery point objectives (RPOs), where applicable, with business and technology owners; challenge gaps between objectives and recovery capabilities.</li>
<li>Set standards for continuity plans and recovery procedures, and facilitate and support accountable owners in developing actionable plans and alternative operating arrangements.</li>
<li>Coordinate business continuity with technology disaster recovery, incident response, and crisis management, with clear activation criteria, escalation paths, and communications responsibilities.</li>
<li>Design and lead a risk-based exercise program, from tabletop simulations to end-to-end recovery tests, and drive lessons learned, remediation tracking, and verification that gaps are closed.</li>
<li>Partner with Third-Party Risk Management and vendor owners to assess critical provider recovery capabilities, contingency arrangements, and concentration dependencies.</li>
<li>Embed continuity considerations into new products, material business changes, and technology implementations.</li>
<li>Establish metrics and reporting that give management and relevant committees visibility into readiness, testing outcomes, material gaps, and overdue remediation.</li>
<li>Build and lead a growing BCM team, including hiring and developing analysts as the program scales over the next year.</li>
<li>Deliver role-based training and promote awareness of continuity responsibilities across the organization.</li>
<li>Support regulatory examinations and bank-launch readiness reviews with accurate documentation and evidence of recovery capability.</li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>Qualifications</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>10+ years of experience in business continuity management, operational resilience, disaster recovery, or a related discipline within a fintech, financial institution, technology company, or other highly regulated environment.</li>
<li>Demonstrated experience building or materially enhancing an enterprise BCM program, including governance, implementation, testing, and reporting.</li>
<li>Strong skills in business impact analysis, critical-service identification, dependency mapping, and recovery objective development.</li>
<li>Experience developing actionable continuity plans and leading exercises that test recovery assumptions and expose gaps.</li>
<li>Sufficient technical fluency to work with Engineering on cloud services, system dependencies, data recovery, and technology disaster recovery.</li>
<li>Working knowledge of third-party risk management, including assessing critical vendor recovery capabilities, contingency arrangements and concentration risk.</li>
<li>Proven ability to drive cross-functional remediation through influence, with a clear view of where BCM oversight ends and business or technology ownership begins.</li>
<li>Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain readiness gaps and tradeoffs to senior leadership.</li>
<li>Experience managing a team of Business Continuity analysts.</li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>Preferred Qualifications</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>Familiarity with banking supervisory expectations for business continuity, and operational resilience.</li>
<li>Experience operating in a company-building or bank-building environment.</li>
<li>Familiarity with recognized continuity standards, such as ISO 22301, and BCM tools for plan management, exercises, and issue tracking.</li>
<li>Relevant professional certification, such as CBCP or MBCI.</li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>Leadership Attributes</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>Pragmatic, first-principles builder who turns ambiguous needs into clear priorities and designs a program that fits Mercury’s operations and scale.</li>
<li>Takes ownership and follows through from identified gaps to demonstrated recovery.</li>
<li>Collaborative, low-ego, and effective across the three lines of defense.</li>
<li>Calm under pressure and able to facilitate clear decisions during disruptions.</li>
<li>Able to challenge constructively, distinguish material gaps from theoretical concerns, and avoid over-engineering.</li>
</ul>
<p>*Mercury is a fintech company, not an FDIC-insured bank. Banking services provided through Choice Financial Group and Column N.A., Members FDIC.</p>

      <title>OfferUp: Software Development Engineer II (Remote @ Colombia)</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote @ Colombia
</p>

<p><strong>About the role:&nbsp;</strong></p>
<p>The OfferUp Connect team builds the moments that turn a listing into a sale. Every chat between buyers and sellers, every offer notification, and every saved-search alert runs through services we own, from messaging and notifications to location, meetups, and the subscriptions sellers pay for. We run high-volume Java microservices and streaming pipelines, integrate with partners like Braze, Amazon Pinpoint, Apple, and Google, and use experimentation to decide what ships.</p>
<p>We also take on high-visibility work beyond our domain. Connect built OfferUp's video infrastructure for listing videos and LLM-powered catalog enrichment on Amazon Bedrock, both company priorities that changed what buyers see every day. The roadmap is wide open for someone who wants to help shape it.</p>
<p>As a Software Development Engineer II, you'll own features from concept to rollout: designing and writing well-tested code, launching experiments, and measuring results with Product, Design, and Data partners. You'll raise the quality of the code around you and get the chance to join the next project like video or catalog enrichment.</p>
<p><strong>Here’s more of what you will get to do:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Design, build, and deploy backend services and event-driven pipelines for messaging, notifications, location, and subscriptions</li>
<li>Improve the reliability, latency, and delivery rates of high-volume messaging and notification systems, including retries, rate limiting, and frequency capping</li>
<li>Integrate with and operate third-party platforms such as Braze, Amazon Pinpoint, Apple and Google push services, and app store billing</li>
<li>Own features end-to-end: plan, design, develop, deploy, measure, and iterate</li>
<li>Break down complex engineering problems into achievable tasks and deliver them within committed timeframes</li>
<li>Work collaboratively with cross-functional teams (Product, Design, Data Science, Marketing, and iOS, Android, and web engineers) to design and implement new features</li>
<li>Contribute to A/B tests and use experimentation results to decide what ships</li>
<li>Actively participate in code reviews and enforce good patterns, testing, and edge-case handling</li>
<li>Coach and mentor junior team members, new hires, and interns</li>
<li>Create shared components, utilities, and services that improve team velocity across the stack</li>
<li>Maintain and improve the runbooks, alerting, and monitoring for the features you ship</li>
<li>Participate in a reasonable on-call rotation with the rest of the team</li>
<li>Use AI coding tools (Claude Code, Gemini, and similar) to increase your daily development velocity and code quality</li>
<li>Become a subject matter expert in one or more of the team's sub-domains: messaging, notifications and campaigns, location, or subscriptions and promotions</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>You’ll thrive in this role if you have:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>2+ years of professional software engineering experience</li>
<li>Demonstrated ability to own the delivery of multiple features end-to-end (plan, design, develop, and deploy) with high efficiency, including breaking down engineering problems into achievable tasks</li>
<li>Strong coding skills in Java, with a working understanding of microservices and distributed-systems fundamentals</li>
<li>Good knowledge of data structures and object-oriented design</li>
<li>Working knowledge of asynchronous, event-driven systems (queues, pub/sub, or streams), including retries and idempotent processing</li>
<li>Hands-on experience using AI coding tools (Claude Code or similar) in a real engineering workflow, and a point of view on when they help and when they don't</li>
<li>A habit of following good coding patterns, writing appropriate tests, considering trade-offs, and seeking out edge cases</li>
<li>Comfortable giving and receiving feedback in code reviews</li>
<li>A bias toward shipping, learning from production, and iterating quickly</li>
<li>An insatiable desire and ability to learn</li>
<li>BS or MS in Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Helpful, but not required:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Fluency in another modern object-oriented programming language</li>
<li>Experience with TypeScript and Node.js</li>
<li>Experience with Agile development</li>
<li>Experience building and integrating with REST APIs</li>
<li>Experience with AWS services such as DynamoDB, SQS, SNS, Lambda, and ElastiCache (Redis)</li>
<li>Experience with notification and engagement platforms (Braze, Amazon Pinpoint, APNs, FCM) or in-app subscription billing (App Store, Google Play)</li>
<li>Experience with stream processing frameworks such as Apache Flink or Kafka Streams</li>
<li>Experience with A/B testing platforms (Statsig, LaunchDarkly, Optimizely) and analytics warehouses (BigQuery, Snowflake)</li>
<li>Experience consuming or integrating LLM-based APIs (e.g., Bedrock, Vertex AI, OpenAI)</li>
<li>Familiarity with Kubernetes, Helm, and CI/CD pipelines</li>
</ul>
<p><br><br></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>About OfferUp:</strong></p>
<p>OfferUp is dedicated to creating the simplest and most trusted way for people to buy, sell, and connect in their local communities. One of the top local marketplace apps for local buyers and sellers in the U.S., OfferUp makes it easy for people to discover more of what they need—from great deals and secondhand goods to jobs, services, home rentals, and more—right in their own communities. Our trusted platform empowers millions to connect, thrive, and move life forward.&nbsp;</p>
<p>Available on iOS and Android, OfferUp has consistently ranked among the top shopping apps. Founded in 2011 and based in Bellevue, WA, OfferUp serves local markets nationwide and was used by more than 1 in 6 adults in the U.S. in 2024. OfferUp is backed by leading investors, including Andreessen Horowitz, Warburg Pincus, GGV Capital, T. Rowe Price, and Coatue Management. https://about.offerup.com</p>
<p><strong>More About OfferUp At a Glance</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Top 10 Shopping app in the App Store and Google Play Store for three years</li>
<li>15%+ of adults in several major markets use OfferUp every month (LA, Miami, Phoenix, Seattle, Las Vegas, Riverside, Orlando)</li>
<li>OfferUp works directly with nearly 2000 US law enforcement agencies to build trust in local communities</li>
</ul>
<p><em>OfferUp is unleashing the power of local, and we’ve built a dynamic team to do it. To learn more about working at OfferUp, check out </em><a href="https://about.offerup.com/people"><em>https://about.offerup.com/people</em></a><em>&nbsp;</em></p>
<p><em>OfferUp provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or genetics. In addition to federal law requirements, OfferUp complies with applicable state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment in every location in which the company has facilities. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.</em></p>
<p><em>OfferUp expressly prohibits any form of workplace harassment based on race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, genetic information, disability, or veteran status. Improper interference with the ability of OfferUp’s employees to perform their job duties may result in discipline up to and including discharge.</em></p></div>

      <title>Maven Clinic: Head of Member Growth (B2B2C)</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> New York, NY; Remote, US (Hub cities)
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><p>Maven Clinic is the world's largest virtual clinic for women and families on a mission to make healthcare work for all of us. Through Maven Enterprise, the company partners with more than 2,300 employers and health plans to provide end-to-end women's and family health programs spanning fertility and family building, maternity and newborn care, parenting and pediatrics, and menopause and midlife — improving clinical outcomes, reducing healthcare costs, and expanding equitable access to high-quality care at scale. Through its consumer platform, Maven provides direct access to virtual care across 30+ specialties, as well as dedicated hormone and GLP-1 care programs purpose-built for women. Founded in 2014 by CEO Kate Ryder, Maven Clinic has raised more than $425 million from leading healthcare and technology investors including General Catalyst, Sequoia, Dragoneer Investment Group, Oak HC/FT, StepStone Group, Icon Ventures, and Lux Capital. Recognized for innovation and industry leadership, Maven has been named to the TIME100 Most Influential Companies, CNBC Disruptor 50, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, and FORTUNE Best Places to Work. Learn more at mavenclinic.com</p>
<p><strong>An award-winning culture working towards an important mission –&nbsp; Maven Clinic is a recipient of over 30 workplace and innovation awards, including:&nbsp;</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>TIME 100 Most Influential Companies (2023, 2026)</li>
<li>Fortune Change the World (2024)</li>
<li>CNBC Disruptor 50 List (2022, 2023, 2024)</li>
<li>Fortune Best Workplaces for Millennials (2024)</li>
<li>Fortune Best Workplaces in Health Care (2024)</li>
<li>Fast Company Most Innovative Companies (2020, 2023)</li>
<li>Fortune Best Workplaces NY (2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024)</li>
</ul></div><h4>About the Role:</h4>
<p>Maven is looking for a Head of Member Growth to own one of the most important numbers in the company: enrollments. This role is directly accountable for driving member enrollment into Maven's programs across our core business — and, by extension, the revenue those enrollments generate. You will own the enrollment engine end to end, from awareness through activation, turning eligible lives into engaged members.</p>
<p>Enrollment is not a single-team problem. It sits at the intersection of nearly every function at Maven, and this role is built for someone who thrives there. You'll partner daily with Client Success (who own the client relationships that unlock eligible populations), Marketing (member acquisition and lifecycle), Product (enrollment experience and funnel), Finance (targets, forecasting, and unit economics), Data (measurement, segmentation, and attribution), and Clinical and Operations teams. Because so many teams touch enrollment, a core part of the job is holding those cross-functional partners accountable to their piece of the machine — the engine only works when every team delivers its part.</p>
<p>This is a player-coach role. You will lead a small, high-caliber team while remaining deeply hands-on yourself every day. Although it carries a Senior Director title, it is explicitly NOT a leaned-out management position for someone who wants to direct a team from a distance. This is a hard requirement: the person in this seat reads the data themselves, pressure-tests the funnel, drafts the plan, and does the work alongside the team. We are looking for a builder and operator who also develops people — not a manager who has stepped away from the work.</p>
<p>We're also looking for someone who can expand the definition of the job. A great deal of enrollment optimization work is already underway, but there is not enough strategic thinking about fundamentally new ways to drive enrollments — approaches that don't simply depend on securing permission to communicate with a client's employees. This role is expected to find and open those new avenues, not just optimize the existing ones.</p>
<h4>What You'll Do:</h4>
<ul>
<li><strong>Own member growth for the Core Business:</strong> Be directly accountable for enrollment targets across Maven's core business and for the revenue those enrollments drive. Set the strategy, build the plan, and act as a control tower across all cross-functional teams driving revenue to deliver the results quarter over quarter.</li>
<li><strong>Build and run a scalable enrollment engine</strong>: Own the full journey from eligible population to enrolled, activated member — spanning client launches, member acquisition and messaging, the enrollment product experience, and re-engagement of eligible-but-not-enrolled members.</li>
<li><strong>Expand the playbook and deliver new strategies to drive sustainable member growth</strong>: Think strategically and from first principles about new ways to grow enrollments beyond today's optimization work — including partnerships and approaches that don't rely solely on permission to communicate with a client's employees. Identify, size, and open avenues that expand the team's purview and unlock new growth.&nbsp;</li>
<li><strong>Optimize relentlessly around data</strong>: Build and consistently iterate on the funnel, and create systems that enable quick diagnoses of opportunities. Build operational metrics that act as leading KPIs for each team contributing to enrollments and bring quantitative rigor into how teams execute against targets.</li>
<li><strong>Hold the cross-functional machine accountable</strong>: Partner daily with Client Success, Marketing, Product, Finance, Data, Clinical, Payer, Sales, and Operations — and hold each team accountable to its operational KPIs in the enrollment process. Serve as the connective tissue that keeps every part of the engine delivering.</li>
<li><strong>Operate as a player-coach</strong>: Lead and develop a small, high-performing team while staying in the execution and details. Set the bar for rigor and hands-on execution by doing the work, coaching through it, and multiplying the team's impact rather than stepping back from it. This is a role that comes with an expectation that you directly execute on the work.</li>
<li><strong>Instrument and forecast</strong>: Partner with Data and Finance to build the measurement, segmentation, attribution, and forecasting needed to know exactly what is and isn't working, and to forecast enrollment and revenue with confidence.</li>
</ul>
<h4>What You'll Bring:</h4>
<ul>
<li>10+ years of experience driving growth, enrollment, acquisition, or revenue outcomes, with a track record of personally owning and hitting a number — ideally in healthcare, benefits, marketplaces, consumer subscription, or another environment with a complex funnel and multiple stakeholders.</li>
<li>A hands-on player-coach. You are energized by being in the details daily — the data, the funnel, the plan, the execution — and you lead a small team as a way to multiply your own hands-on impact, not to step back from the work. This is a hard requirement for the role.&nbsp;</li>
<li>Elite quantitative ability as a core competency. You can build and interrogate a funnel model yourself, size opportunities, design experiments, and instinctively optimize around data rather than intuition. Strong quant is non-negotiable.</li>
<li>Strategic range. Beyond optimizing what exists, you can spot and pursue fundamentally new approaches to enrollment that expand the team's purview — not just incremental improvements to current channels.</li>
<li>Cross-functional leadership and accountability. Proven ability to align and mobilize many teams — Client Success, Marketing, Product, Finance, Data, Clinical, Operations — around a shared goal without direct authority over most of them, and to hold each accountable to its operational commitments.</li>
<li>Commercial instincts. You understand how enrollment translates into revenue and unit economics, and you can partner with Finance on targets and forecasting.</li>
<li>Comfort in a fast-paced, mission-driven environment with high visibility and direct accountability for a top-line company metric.</li>
</ul>
<p>The base salary range for this role is $204,000.00 - $270,000.00 per year. You will also be entitled to receive bonus, equity, and benefits. Individual pay decisions are based on qualifications, experience, and skillset.</p>
<p><strong>This role requires active work authorization in the US.</strong></p>
<p>Maven embraces a flexible hybrid work model. Our teams primarily operate from the New York Metropolitan area, NY, and remotely via San Francisco/Bay Area, CA, Seattle, WA. For those in our New York City office, we encourage in-person collaboration by requiring team members to work onsite three days a week&nbsp; (Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday). For those based in Boston, DC, Chicago, Seattle, and San Francisco, we encourage in-person collaboration by requiring team members to attend monthly Work Together Days within these cities. This policy aims to balance remote work flexibility with the benefits of face-to-face interaction.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p class="p1">At Maven we believe that a diverse set of backgrounds and experiences enrich our teams and allow us to achieve above and beyond our goals. If you do not have experience in all of the areas detailed above, we hope that you will share your unique background with us in your application and how it can be additive to our teams.</p>
<p><strong>Benefits That Work For You</strong></p>
<p>Our benefits are designed to support your health, well-being and career development, helping you thrive both personally and professionally. We remain focused on providing a competitive benefits package for our employees. On top of standards such as employer-covered health, dental, and insurance plan options, we offer an inclusive approach to benefits:</p>
<ul>
<li>Maven for Mavens: access to the full platform and specialists, including care for mental health, reproductive health, family planning and pediatrics.</li>
<li>Whole-self care through wellness partnerships</li>
<li>Hybrid work, in office meals, and work together days&nbsp;</li>
<li>16 weeks 100% paid parental leave and new parent stipend (for Mavens who've been with us for 1 year+)</li>
<li>Annual professional development stipend and access to a personal career coach through Maven for Mavens</li>
<li>401K matching for US-based employees, with immediate vesting</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>These benefits are applicable to Maven Clinic Co., US-based, full-time employees only. 1099/Contract Providers are ineligible for these benefits.&nbsp;</strong></p>
<p>Maven is an affirmative action and equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or genetic information. Maven is committed to providing access, equal opportunity and reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities in employment, its services, programs, and activities. Maven Clinic interview requests and job offers only originate from an @mavenclinic.com email address (e.g jsmith@mavenclinic.com). Maven Clinic will never ask for sensitive information to be delivered over email or phone. <span>If you receive a scam issue or a security issue involving Maven Clinic please notify us at: </span><a href="mailto:security@mavenclinic.com"><span>security@mavenclinic.com</span></a><span>. </span>For general and additional inquiries, please contact us at&nbsp;<a href="mailto:careers@mavenclinic.com">careers@mavenclinic.com</a>.&nbsp;</p></div>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/maven-clinic-head-of-member-growth-b2b2c">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/maven-clinic-head-of-member-growth-b2b2c</a></p>
</description>

      <title>Reddit: Analytics Engineer</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote - United States
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><div class="c-message_kit__blocks c-message_kit__blocks--rich_text">
<div class="c-message__message_blocks c-message__message_blocks--rich_text">
<div class="p-block_kit_renderer">
<div class="p-block_kit_renderer__block_wrapper p-block_kit_renderer__block_wrapper--first">
<div class="p-rich_text_block">
<div class="p-rich_text_section">Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit <a class="c-link" href="http://www.redditinc.com/">www.redditinc.com</a>.</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div></div><p>We are looking for a talented and driven individual to be a key part of our Analytics Engineering team within the Data Science organization. We are looking for someone who can work closely with Data Scientists and Engineers across diverse areas of the organization (Consumer, Ads, and Marketing) to curate, develop, and deploy the right data and analytic tooling to drive Reddit’s product forward and provide a data and tooling foundation that will last decades. Your work will empower thousands of your colleagues to improve the user experience and grow our consumer base.</p>
<p>Successful candidates have a strong track record of understanding and deeply caring about the purpose of data to support business goals, and can act as an effective conduit between Data Producers and Data Consumers. This role sits at the intersection of Data Science and Data Engineering, and the ideal candidate has skills, experience, and passion in both areas.</p>
<p><strong>Responsibilities:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Be a key contributor and collaborator to the success of data quality, performance, reliability, and automation initiatives.</li>
<li>Manage a portfolio of data products that deliver high-quality, trustworthy data</li>
<li>Develop and maintain robust data pipelines and workflows for data ingestion, processing, and transformation. Work closely with engineering to ensure the quality and reliability of these data pipelines.</li>
<li>Develop and implement data quality checks, conduct QA and implement monitoring routines</li>
<li>Create and manage new data integrations across internal and external systems</li>
<li>Create tools and applications for internal use that streamline data analysis and reporting. Drive widespread adoption of these tools and applications with a relentless focus on automation, consistency, and reliability.</li>
<li>Serve as a thought partner for data scientists, engineering managers, and leadership on data foundations, communicating and shaping the data foundations roadmap and strategy for Reddit.<br><br></li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Qualifications:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Bachelor's degree in computer science or a quant educational field</li>
<li>3+ years of experience working with large-scale ETL systems (implementation, strategy, and maintenance), building clean, maintainable code and systems (Python preferred) in a production environment.</li>
<li>Strong programming proficiency in Python, SQL, Spark, Scala, etc.</li>
<li>Experience with data modeling, ETL and ELT concepts, and patterns for efficient data governance. Experience with manipulating massive-scale structured and unstructured data.</li>
<li>Experience with data workflows (such as Airflow), data modeling, front-end or back-end engineering.</li>
<li>Experience in data analysis and dashboard design.</li>
<li>Deep understanding of technical and functional designs for relational and MPP Databases.</li>
<li>Proven track record of cross-functional execution and collaboration.&nbsp;</li>
<li>Agentic AI-assisted development experience.</li>
<li>Excellent communication skills to collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders at all levels of the company, of differing levels of technical acumen.</li>
<li>Self-starter, ability to work independently and autonomously, as well as part of a team.<br><br></li>
</ul>
<p>Check out our r/RedditEng post to learn more about the team, and what we do: <a href="https://www.reddit.com/r/RedditEng/comments/1mnmf71/analytics_engineering_reddit/">https://www.reddit.com/r/RedditEng/comments/1mnmf71/analytics_engineering_reddit/</a>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>Benefits:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Comprehensive Healthcare Benefits and Income Replacement Programs</li>
<li>401k with Employer Match</li>
<li>Global Benefit programs that fit your lifestyle, from workspace to professional development to caregiving support</li>
<li>Family Planning Support</li>
<li>Gender-Affirming Care</li>
<li>Mental Health &amp; Coaching Benefits</li>
<li>Flexible Vacation &amp; Paid Volunteer Time Off</li>
<li>Generous Paid Parental Leave&nbsp;</li>
</ul>
<p>#LI-Remote</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><strong>Pay Transparency:</strong></p>
<p>This job posting may span more than one career level.</p>
<p>In addition to base salary, this job is eligible to receive equity in the form of restricted stock units, and depending on the position offered, it may also be eligible to receive a commission. Additionally, Reddit offers a wide range of benefits to U.S.-based employees, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) program with employer match, generous time off for vacation, and parental leave. To learn more, please visit <a href="https://www.redditinc.com/careers/">https://www.redditinc.com/careers/</a>.</p>
<p>To provide greater transparency to candidates, we share base salary ranges for all US-based job postings regardless of state. We set standard base pay ranges for all roles based on function, level, and country location, benchmarked against similar stage growth companies. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including, skills, depth of work experience and relevant licenses/credentials, and may vary from the amounts listed below.</p></div><div class="title">The base salary range for this position is:</div><div class="pay-range"><span>$164,200</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>$229,990 USD</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><p>In select roles and locations, the interviews will be recorded, transcribed and summarized by artificial intelligence (AI). You will have the opportunity to opt out of recording, transcription and summarization prior to any scheduled interviews.</p>
